title: The punch, then the callout names it

aliases.name: The punch on the emphasized datum, then the callout names it

members.role: the page spirals in on the turn of the argument
the camera punches to the datum almost on the page's own frame - the number gets the camera first

does: The number that turns the argument gets the camera before it gets a label: the page arrives, the punch lands on the datum, and only then does the callout name it.
